capture.final_message:
Split the outer conjunction. In each `Iff`, observe that both universally quantified propositions are standard results available independently, so each implication may ignore its hypothesis.

- For the first `Iff`, use the defining properties of `WithSeminorms`: every generating seminorm `p i` is continuous, and the induced topology makes `E` a topological additive group.
- For the second, use the vector-valued Hadamard three-lines theorem for the left side. For the right side, apply the standard characterization of continuity of a seminorm on a seminormed space:
  \[
  q\text{ continuous}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \exists C>0,\ \forall x,\ q(x)\le C\|x\|.
  \]
  This comes from continuity at zero together with the absolute homogeneity of `q`; the nontrivially normed field assumption is the key hypothesis enabling the global rescaling argument.

Thus prove all four universal assertions directly from the corresponding library lemmas, then assemble the two equivalences and their conjunction.
